hypothesis: A repaired Stage0 H1 grid that uses a posterior-normalized P(G|Z) correction operator aligned to the estimand subgroup prior, explicitly varies subgroup-prior imbalance, and evaluates signed plus magnitude diagnostics will recover positive-vs-negative mechanism separation only when the original exp001-style prior-weighted posterior distortion is present.

condition_counting.observed_directional_conditions_definiti: Condition rows after expanding correlation_direction in {positive, negative}.

H1a.description: posterior-normalized operator P(G|Z) aligns correction algebra with the estimand subgroup-prior weighting

H1b.description: subgroup-prior imbalance is required to recover exp001-style worst-case prior leverage

H1c.description: signed or signed+magnitude diagnostics are required because magnitude-only bias_bound_score confounds positive and negative controls

success_rules.H1a: posterior_minus_transition_inverse_gate_rmse < 0 with bootstrap 95% CI upper bound < 0; posterior_operator_alignment_error passes numerical tolerance; oracle and estimated inputs reported separately
success_rules.H1b: imbalanced_prior_positive_minus_negative_rate_diff exceeds uniform_prior_positive_minus_negative_rate_diff with bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
success_rules.H1c: signed_bias_alignment_vs_global_worse_spearman >= 0.50 with bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 and positive_negative_signed_score_separation CI lower bound > 0
success_rules.overall: H1a, H1b, and H1c all pass; repaired posterior-global positive-vs-negative worse-rate difference >= 20 percentage points in imbalanced-prior axes with bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0

negative_rules.H1a: posterior correction does not beat transition_transpose_inverse or operator alignment checks fail
negative_rules.H1b: prior imbalance does not increase positive-vs-negative separation versus uniform prior
negative_rules.H1c: signed diagnostic does not rank global-worse conditions in expected direction or CI includes nonpositive rank/separation
negative_rules.overall: any H1a/H1b/H1c negative keeps Stage1 blocked unless Director explicitly waives C002

stop_conditions: registry status would move beyond PREPARING
command would launch submit_training_job, tmux, nohup, or GPU allocation
condition_pair_id or directional_condition_id missing from output contract
replications or bootstrap iterations below formal minimum
